sloka: साहं कथं करिष्यामि तं विना प्रियदर्शनम् ।रामं रक्तान्तनयनमपश्यन्ती सुदुःखिता ।। ५.२४.३५।।।।
transliteration: sāhaṁ kathaṁ kariṣyāmi taṁ vinā priyadarśanam ।rāmaṁ raktāntanayanamapaśyantī suduḥkhitā ।। 5.24.35।।।।

translations.english: 'O timid Sita know that youth of women is fleeting and transient. Before it is over, enjoy all kinds of pleasures.
